mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, run_id, tool_name, description, status, response_id, created_at, resolved_at FROM agent_run_permission_request WHERE request_id = #{requestId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_run_permission_request (request_id, run_id, tool_name, description, status, response_id, created_at, resolved_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{runId}, #{toolName}, #{description}, #{status}, #{responseId}, #{createdAt}, #{resolvedAt})
